decision.rationale: The exact snapshot is green and GitHub-mergeable, but every LP-02 write route can return a generic 500 when an overlapping same-key request exceeds the configured lock timeout. The stable inherited idempotency contract requires a retryable 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS response.

summary: PR #4 implements the planned LP-02 execution and human-decision loop with strong contracts, persistence constraints, confirmation binding, and broad tests. One exact-head defect blocks approval: the new LP-02 runWrite helper omits LP-01's PostgreSQL 55P03 mapping, and a reviewer-held same-key transaction produced HTTP 500 after 2.1 seconds instead of the stable 409 in-progress result required for safe idempotent recovery.

findings.title: LP-02 same-key lock contention escapes as HTTP 500
findings.observation: The helper configures a two-second lock timeout but rolls back and rethrows PostgreSQL 55P03. Unlike the accepted LP-01 helper, it never converts that normal idempotency-key contention case into the stable retryable 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS result.
findings.trigger: An LP-02 request uses the same idempotency key while the first transaction remains uncommitted longer than two seconds.
findings.impact: All LP-02 write endpoints can return 500 INTERNAL_ERROR for a normal overlapping retry, so clients cannot follow the inherited deterministic same-key recovery protocol required by LP2-REQ-021 and LP2-AC-003/012.

evidence.description: LP-02 runWrite rethrows after rollback, while LP-01 maps error code 55P03 to its inProgress result.
On exact head, an uncommitted idempotency row held review-held-lp02-key; POST project transition returned 500 INTERNAL_ERROR after 2121ms rather than 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.
LP2-REQ-021 inherits same-key replay semantics and LP2-AC-003/012 require deterministic concurrency and safe recovery behavior.
The accepted LP-01 integration suite already defines the held-key timeout behavior, but no equivalent LP-02 regression exists.

findings.remediation: Reuse a shared command-transaction helper or map 55P03 in LP-02 after rollback to the existing IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS result. Add an LP-02 held-key integration regression and preserve commit/rollback replay behavior.
findings.verification: The focused regression fails on 478e46b, passes on the remediation head with status 409 and code IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, and all static, contract, integration, LP-01 acceptance, and LP-02 acceptance gates pass.

required_actions.action: Restore the stable 55P03 to 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS mapping for every LP-02 write and add a held-key regression.
